record.title: Cementitious Repair Mortars - Industrial and Building Concrete Repair
record.description:
Specifies composition, fresh-state properties, hardened performance, and application-related requirements for pre-bagged cementitious repair mortars used for patching and restoration of concrete substrates.

Applies to non-structural and defined repair applications where the repair material is mixed and placed according to the manufacturer instructions; excludes resin-based repair systems.

Key requirements: Specified compressive strength shall be achieved at the declared test age.; Fresh mortar shall meet workable consistency and water-demand limits.; Bond performance to the defined concrete substrate shall meet the acceptance threshold.; Packaging shall identify mixing instructions and declared batch information.

Testing requirements: Compressive strength test on prepared mortar specimens.; Bond strength or pull-off test on the defined substrate configuration.; Water demand and workability verification.; Drying shrinkage screening where declared.

Documentation required: Technical data sheet.; Batch certificate or quality-control record.; Laboratory performance report.; Application instructions.

Marking requirements: Product name and manufacturer identification.; Declared class or performance designation.; Batch number and date of manufacture.; Storage and mixing instructions.
record.certification_applicability: Certification generally voluntary unless a project specification, procurement condition, or applicable order requires conformity to this standard.
